disclaimer: Historical research reconciliation only. Not a profitability claim. No strategy parameters changed.

issues.title: Visible ~+$231.28 vs report +$274.04 is gross vs net, not a ledger bug
issues.detail: On DB-tail 12,200 bars (fingerprint e3e4c05faf4454ec), report pnl_usd (Gross PnL) = +274.0452 and pnl_usd_net = +231.2394. Summing blotter Net columns reproduces +231.24; summing Gross reproduces +274.05. Fees = -42.8058. Identity gross + fees = net holds exactly.
issues.evidence: tail_12200.json; frontend matrix columns Gross PnL / Net PnL; blotter Gross/Net columns

issues.title: Configuration fingerprint ignores DB-tail bar limit
issues.detail: e3e4c05faf4454ec is shared by limit=8640 (19 trades) and limit=12200 (33 trades). Fingerprint payload in backtest_ui_config.configuration_fingerprint does not include limit, so two different datasets collide under one fingerprint.

issues.title: average_R * n * risk_usd does not equal sized gross PnL when leverage-capped
issues.detail: On the 33-trade run, sum(r_multiple)*20 = 300.26 while sized gross PnL = 274.05 (18/33 trades capped_by_leverage). Summary correctly uses sized gross_pnl_usd sums; naive R*$risk is not the report Gross PnL.

issues.title: Open trades are excluded from summary and blotter enrichment
issues.detail: enrich_trades(closed_only=True) drops outcome=OPEN. sample_size counts closed only. No open trade was present in the 33-trade dump.

issues.title: No silent calendar→DB-tail conversion on audited calendar runs
issues.detail: 2e654bef (2026-01-01→2026-10-05) and 31b236ff (2026-02-01→2026-04-30) both report period_mode=CALENDAR_RANGE with actual first/last candles inside the requested UTC dates. The 33-trade +$274 run is an explicit DB_TAIL max lookback, not a mislabeled calendar request.
issues.evidence: requested_range vs actual_range in dump JSONs

issues.title: All three fingerprints use forming HTF (not fully closed)
issues.detail: htf_require_fully_closed=false on every trade condition_snapshot. 4h coverage formula is limit//4 + 100 (8640→2260, 12200→3150).

issues.title: No missing/duplicated trades; summary recomputes from ledger with zero delta
issues.detail: Across four dumps, trade_id / entry_index / (signal_time, exit_time) are unique; sample_size equals closed row count; gross/net/fees/avg R/PF/max DD R deltas are 0.
